title: Theme 4 writing plan
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y11 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Theme 4 writing plan)
intro: Lesson 36: Revision Theme 4: writing about my future. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
بَعْدَ الاِمْتِحَانَاتِ سَأَدْرُسُ الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ فِي الكُلِّيَّةِ.
أَحْلُمُ بِأَنْ أَكُونَ مُهَنْدِسًا لِأَنَّنِي أُحِبُّ حَلَّ المُشْكِلَاتِ.
إِذَا تَعَلَّمْتُ العَرَبِيَّةَ جَيِّدًا، فَسَأَعْمَلُ فِي بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ.

questions.q: Write a conditional sentence about learning languages.
questions.a: e.g. إِذَا تَعَلَّمْتُ لُغَةً جَدِيدَةً، فَسَأُسَافِرُ أَكْثَرَ.

questions.q: Timed writing (our own task) in the portal response box: 150 words (Group B 90 words) covering every bullet, in 25 minutes.
Extend: self-check with the error clinic list.
